casePolicy: Locally committed bounded authored-input paragraphs. Exact preservation only. No expected-output, route, action or executable fields. New input files do not change checker source.
runtimeAdmission: Actual clean current main, pinned Lab code and immutable runtime input. All raw checks and atomic paired publication required.
uniqueCredit: Two fixed product cell IDs; input variants and repeats never multiply the numerator

qualifiedRuntimeRepair.scope: Compact reference transport with unchanged raw preservation oracle and IPC limits; requires fresh native evidence, no historical PASS carry-forward

followupRepair.scope: Four inline marks through existing DOCX and canonical scene path. No whole-STYLES credit. Fresh TEXT/ORDER evidence remains required for DATA admission.

navigatorCounterRepair.scope: Navigator uses decoded visible text; raw identity hashes remain unchanged. No whole-cell credit; fresh native evidence remains required.

ciSchedulingRepair.scope: CI scheduling only: unchanged post-audit and RTK command blocks run in parallel after separate builds. Protected aggregate failure gate unchanged. No runtime or whole-cell credit.

headingRepair.scope: Product repair: preserve existing heading levels 1 to 6 through DOCX export, bounded outline/style parsing, preview filters and admitted doc-v2 import. No full-STYLES credit.

listRepair.scope: Product repair: preserve existing bullet and decimal lists with start numbers, item boundaries and bounded nesting through DOCX export, bounded numbering parsing, preview filters and admitted doc-v2 import. No full-STYLES credit.

listMarkerRepair.scope: Mechanical existing-editor repair: keep native list markers in the same paginated line flow as their first paragraph, preserving native list semantics, commands, stored content and transfer behavior. No full-STYLES credit.

colorRepair.scope: Product repair: preserve opaque RGB text and highlight colors through minimal DOCX, actual Word return and admitted rich import; reuse existing review encoding and correct native Word palette. No full-STYLES credit.

typographyRepair.scope: Product repair: preserve uniform named fonts and exact half-point sizes through the existing editor, both DOCX writers, Word return and admitted rich import; measure actual renderer font fallback. No full-STYLES credit.

paragraphAlignmentRepair.scope: Product repair: preserve paragraph alignment through existing structured commands, DOCX writers and readers, Word return and admitted persisted import; keep all rich text and undo. No full-STYLES credit.

themeFontRepair.scope: Product repair: resolve supported Word theme selections through bounded existing readers and admitted import; preserve text, explicit overrides and loss diagnostics. No full-STYLES credit.

wordManuscriptBatch.scope: Complete native manuscript journeys, including explicitly selected canonical notes carried by native footnotes and endnotes, independent raw body/anchor/order readback, actual Word text readback and sidecar no-write continuity. Existing fields remain mandatory.
limitations: Native Chromium composition on the bound macOS locale does not certify every OS IME engine.
Actual fallback fonts and Word declarations do not certify pixel identity.
Unsupported document objects reject the bounded proof; generic C1 declares metadata and bookmark loss.
Tracked property changes are explicitly classified and preserved as manual-review information; this does not claim automatic formatting acceptance or merging edited existing comments.
Native Word truncates core created timestamps to UTC minute precision; the signed custom property retains the exact canonical instant and cross-minute drift is rejected.

googleNativeTransport.scope: Current C5 manuscript evidence only; supersedes the archived connector transport assumption, not the frozen axes or any historical cell evidence.
